name: Compass
subtitle: 指南针示例项目
description: 利用方向传感器组件,制作一个简易的指南针应用。当方位角为 0 度时,手机屏幕的顶端指向正北。使用组件:画布、精灵、方向传感器。

name: DIYBookClub
subtitle: Wire and share book reviews with friends.
description: Create an app that lets you and your friends write and share reviews of your favorite books. Inspired by YR Media's story about audiobooks on Youtube.

name: DontGetFaked
subtitle: Quiz app to detect if a story is fake or not.
description: Create a quiz app that can test a user's ability to detect if a story is fake or not. Inspired by YR Media video and online quiz.

name: HelloPurr
subtitle: A purring kitty app
description: This is App Inventor's version of the HelloWorld app. For more information see the HelloPurr tutorial.

name: HelloPurrStarter
subtitle: A purring kitty app
description: This is a starter file for the Hello Purr project where cat image and sound are already uploaded.

name: Magic
subtitle: 变魔术示例项目
description: 一个简单的魔术游戏。手机屏幕上显示一张鸭子的图片,点击屏幕鸭子发出叫声;摇晃手机鸭子消失;再次摇晃鸭子重新出现并发出叫声。

name: MapTheMovement
subtitle: Search for Twitter hashtags by location using a map.
description: You're challenged with creating an app that shows what's happening on Twitter in any given location on a map. Inspired by YR Media's interactive tracker of student led action.

name: MoodRing
subtitle: Track your feelings and reach out to others having a rough time.
description:
Mood Ring invites teens to track how theyre feeling using any combo of nine emojis, and to reach out to trusted others when theyre having a rough time.
Inspired by YR Media stories Only Smiling on the Outside: Teens Hide Depression and Could Your Next Therapist Be Your Phone?

name: MyToDoList
subtitle: Keep track of your daily tasks.
description: Keep on top of your to-do list, by creating an app where you can add and remove tasks from your list. Inspired by YR Media video on bullet journaling.

name: Palette
subtitle: 画板调色示例项目
description: 利用画板组件做一个简易的调色板应用,通过触摸屏幕给画板涂色,演示 Canvas 组件的画线与画点能力。

name: SimpleChatbot
subtitle: Create your very own ChatGPT app.
description: Build a simple app that allows users to connect to ChatGPT, ask questions, and have a conversation

name: SnapchatRemix
subtitle: Take a photo, then draw on it in different colors.
description: Make an app that can take a photo and set it as the background, draw different-colored dots and lines on the photo, and sends the photo to your friends. Inspired by NPR story Snapchat Goes Public In Largest Tech IPO Since Alibaba.

name: SoundLibrary
subtitle: Capture, store, and play found sounds.
description: You are challenged to create an app that captures, stores and plays sounds. Inspired by YR Media story and videos Making Beats on the Street with Found Sounds.

name: TranslateApp
subtitle: Quickly translate English to Spanish (and other languages too!)
description: You're challenged with creating an app that could act as an aid for immigrant parents who need a little extra help in English-speaking situations. Inspired by YR Media story What It's Like to be a Translator.
